extraction.diagnosis:
COPD exacerbation (flare-up of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease), triggered by a viral chest
infection.
extraction.hospital_summary: Admitted with AECOPD in the setting of rhinovirus infection. Treated with BiPAP for 12 hours, then weaned to 2 L NC; received methylprednisolone 40 mg IV daily x 3 days, transitioned to oral prednisone taper, and azithromycin. Qualified for home oxygen with exertion and sleep; inhaled regimen escalated; smoking cessation counseling provided; NRT started.

medications.name: Prednisone
Azithromycin
medications.source_quote: Azithromycin 250 mg tablet. Take 1 tablet by mouth once daily for 3 more days (10/17, 10/18 and 10/19).

medications.name: Tiotropium (Spiriva Respimat)
special_instructions: at the same time each day
medications.source_quote: Tiotropium (Spiriva Respimat) 2.5 mcg inhaler. Take 2 inhalations once daily, at the same time each day.

medications.name: Nicotine patch
special_instructions: If you have vivid dreams, take the patch off at bedtime.
medications.source_quote:
Nicotine patch 14 mg/24 hours. Apply 1 new patch each morning to clean, hairless skin. Remove the old patch
first. If you have vivid dreams, take the patch off at bedtime.

medications.name: Fluticasone-salmeterol (Advair Diskus)
special_instructions: Rinse your mouth with water and spit after each use.
medications.source_quote:
Fluticasone-salmeterol (Advair Diskus) 250/50 mcg. Take 1 inhalation twice daily, morning and evening. Rinse
your mouth with water and spit after each use. Strength increased from 100/50.

medications.name: Albuterol HFA
medications.purpose: for shortness of breath or wheezing
medications.source_quote: Albuterol HFA 90 mcg inhaler. Take 2 puffs every 4 to 6 hours as needed for shortness of breath or wheezing.

medications.name: Omeprazole
medications.purpose: to protect your stomach while on prednisone
medications.source_quote:
Omeprazole 20 mg capsule. Take 1 capsule by mouth once daily before breakfast, to protect your stomach while
on prednisone.

explanation.summary: You were in the hospital because your COPD (a lung disease) got worse. A virus in your chest caused this flare-up. You needed breathing support and medicines to help you breathe, and now you are going home with oxygen and a plan to help your lungs heal.

m1.how_to_take: Take by mouth once a day with breakfast. Take 4 tablets (40 mg) on 10/17 and 10/18. Then take 3 tablets (30 mg) on 10/19 and 10/20. Then take 2 tablets (20 mg) on 10/21 and 10/22. Then take 1 tablet (10 mg) on 10/23 and 10/24.
tips: After you take the last dose on 10/24, stop taking this medicine.

m2.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet by mouth once a day for 3 more days: 10/17, 10/18, and 10/19.

tips: Try to take it at the same time every day.

m4.how_to_take: Put on 1 new patch each morning.
tips: Stick the new patch onto clean skin that has no hair.
Take off the old patch before you put on the new one.
If you have vivid dreams at night, take the patch off at bedtime.

m5.how_to_take: Take 1 inhalation 2 times a day, once in the morning and once in the evening.
tips: After you use it, rinse your mouth with water and spit it out.
This medicine was made stronger. It was 100/50 and is now 250/50.

m6.what_for: For shortness of breath or wheezing.
m6.how_to_take: Take 2 puffs every 4 to 6 hours, only when you need it for shortness of breath or wheezing. Do not use it more than 6 times in one day.

m7.what_for: To protect your stomach while you are taking prednisone.
m7.how_to_take: Take 1 capsule by mouth once a day, before breakfast.

w1.who_to_call: Call the Lung Center at (203) 555-0177 if you notice any of these signs.
signs: You need your albuterol more often than every 4 hours.
Your mucus turns green or yellow and you have a fever.

w2.who_to_call: Call 911 or go to the emergency room right away.
signs: You are so short of breath that you cannot speak in full sentences.
Your lips or fingertips turn blue.
You become confused or very sleepy.

i1.text: Use your oxygen at 2 liters per minute through your nose tube when you walk around and while you sleep.

i2.text: The oxygen company will bring your oxygen equipment to your home on 10/16/2026.

i3.text: Do not smoke, especially near your oxygen, because it can start a fire. If you want free help to quit smoking, call 1-800-QUIT-NOW.

a1.text: You have a visit with Dr. Sofia Alvarez in Pulmonology on October 27, 2026, at 2:30 PM, at Maplewood Lung Center, 3rd floor. Bring all of your inhalers with you.

a2.text: The pulmonary rehabilitation program will call you within 2 weeks to set up your program.

a3.text: Call your primary care doctor within 1 week to set up a follow-up visit.
